Passed all practice tests except one where i missed one question and failed, today when I went to take my permit test, the questions were completely different and I failed it, do not waste your time on this app.

reviews.title: Permit Test Answers
reviews.text: This app looks good and helpful but it has incorrect answers. The one answer I encountered that was supposedly wrong was “The front tires are supposed to be facing away from the curb when parking on a downhill slope” when the correct answer is “The front tires are supposed to face the curb when parking on a downhill slope”. The thing that makes it more upsetting is that it even asks what State you are in and it still has incorrect answers. Like come on, if you are going to help people with an app, actually study across different websites including the DMV of each state so you dont give your customers incorrect information.
